responsibility: Declares the public entry points for the Rust front end’s AST-to-HIR lowering pass. It exposes the crate-level ASTLowering driver that turns an AST::Crate into an HIR::Crate, the visibility translation helper that desugars AST visibility into HIR visibility/path data, and a utility for detecting duplicate struct-field names during data-type lowering. This header is the compact public façade over the larger family of specialized lowering visitors.
same_name_distinction: Provides the minimal public declarations for invoking AST-to-HIR lowering and related helpers like visibility translation, while rust-ast-lower.cc contains the actual crate traversal and shared lowering implementations.
